backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a pickleball scheduling app with user profiles, availability tracking, leaderboard stats, daily logs, posts/reactions, and access control using mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the PWA splash screen update (full-screen background image without logo overlay) is implemented in frontend/index.html and manifest.webmanifest.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React components, hooks, pages, and utilities describing their functionality, layout patterns, and data flow.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements like backgrounds, borders, cards, and charts.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, manifest link, iOS-specific configuration, and apple-touch-startup-image tags pointing to a full-screen background image URL for splash screens.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata (name, colors, orientation) and icon URLs hosted on blob.caffeine.ai for various sizes and purposes.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with styled "You're Offline" message and retry button, served by the service worker when network is unavailable.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing network-first caching strategy with offline fallback, precaching core assets, and skipping IC/Internet Identity domains from cache.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component that handles authentication flow, routing setup with Tanstack Router, and initializes user profile and leaderboard data. Includes AuthGate wrapper for protected routes and manages loading/error states during authentication.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access denied message with a shield icon for users attempting to access admin-only pages. Provides a button to return to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen component with background image overlay that displays app logo and sign-in button using Internet Identity authentication. Shows loading state during authentication process.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple component that renders the application logo image with configurable className, using branding constants for URL and alt text.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Main chat interface component that displays threaded messages in a scrollable area with a message composer supporting text and image attachments. Handles message sending with upload progress tracking and error handling.
frontend/src/components/chat/ImageAttach: Image attachment picker component that validates and previews selected images before upload. Provides file selection button and displays thumbnail preview with remove option.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReactionCon: Reaction buttons component for posts with like/dislike functionality, implementing optimistic UI updates and handling reaction addition/removal. Tracks local state for immediate feedback before server confirmation.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReplyCompos: Reply input form component for threaded chat posts, supporting text and image attachments with upload progress tracking. Includes submit and cancel buttons with proper loading states.
frontend/src/components/chat/ThreadedPos: Renders a recursive tree of threaded posts with replies, showing author avatars, timestamps, content, images, reactions, and inline reply composers. Supports nested indentation and fetches user directory data for all authors in the thread.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Displays an error alert with a title, message, and optional retry/secondary action buttons. Uses shadcn/ui Alert components with destructive variant.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Provides two loading spinner components: FullPageLoading for full-screen loading states and InlineLoading for inline loading with configurable sizes (sm/md/lg).
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout wrapper that includes offline banner, top bar, navigation, main content area with safe-area padding, and footer with Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Horizontal navigation bar with Calendar, Leaderboard, Profile, and conditionally Admin tabs. Highlights active route and uses icons from lucide-react.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageLayou: Provides Page and PageHeader components for consistent page structure with configurable max-width constraints and optional header icons/actions.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Top application bar with app logo, user avatar dropdown with logout, theme toggle, and PWA install button. Shows install instructions dialog for iOS devices.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Editable profile card allowing users to update their display name and upload a custom profile picture with progress tracking. Validates image type and size (max 5MB).
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the current user's all-time rank on the leaderboard by finding their position in the leaderboard data array.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows a list of the user's match history by day with wins and losses counts. Handles loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name on first login. Cannot be dismissed and blocks interaction until name is provided.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: Dialog component that displays step-by-step instructions for installing the PWA, with different instructions for iOS (using Share button) and Android (using menu button).
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: Banner component that displays a fixed notification at the top of the screen when the user goes offline, using browser online/offline events.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wrapper component that renders a fixed, low-opacity court background image behind all children content.
Component that displays a user's avatar (with fallback to initials) and display name, with configurable sizes (sm/md/lg) and loading states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile using React Query, with automatic cache invalidation on save.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides hooks to query the current user's role and admin status from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Hook that manages PWA installation prompts, detecting iOS/Android, standalone mode, and providing a function to trigger the native install prompt.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching user profiles, leaderboard, availability data, posts, and reactions from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Hook that manages light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence and applies the theme class to the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and cache user profiles (display names and avatars) for given principals, with fallback to truncated principal strings when profiles are unavailable.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors, safe area insets for mobile standalone mode, and global layout styles.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports centralized branding constants including app name and logo URL for the Somers Scheduler application.
frontend/src/lib/chatThreads.ts: Provides functions to build a multi-level thread tree from flat post lists and flatten it for rendering with depth information, handling missing parents defensively.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for date manipulation including converting dates to/from dayId format (YYYYMMDD as bigint), generating calendar grids, and formatting dates/times for display.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page component for adding or editing user availability for a specific date with time selection and optional notes, pre-populating existing availability if present.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin-only page displaying tables of registered users and availabilities with delete functionality, showing access denied screen for non-admin users.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Displays a monthly calendar grid with availability counts per day, navigation controls, and an embedded chat panel. Links to day detail pages and add availability form.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple page wrapper that displays the ChatPanel component with a header. Provides a dedicated full-screen view for group chat.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows all players available on a specific date with their time ranges and notes. Allows the current user to edit or delete their own availability entry.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays ranked player statistics (wins/losses/win rate) in a table, allows recording match results for available days, and shows toast notifications for rank changes.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page displaying profile card, leaderboard ranking, and match history using composed profile components.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides utilities for converting files to Uint8Array, extracting initials from names, and validating image file types and sizes.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Time utility functions for parsing and formatting 12-hour time strings with AM/PM, generating hour/minute options, and providing default time components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, persisting parameters in sessionStorage, and clearing sensitive parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file that defines custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, custom animations (accordion), and includes typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting a PWA app with two feature requests: implementing a full-screen splash screen background image without logo (in progress) and adding chat message edit/delete functionality for message owners (pending).
